(a), (b), and (c) are all types of different seating arrangements. Classroom-type is also a type of 
seating arrangement. 
A horseshoe arrangement allows eye contact between the instructor and the trainees. It is ideal when the 
presentation includes a demonstration and also allows the trainees to have large group discussions. 
In fan-type seating, the trainees can see from any point in the room and can easily listen to a presentation as well as 
engage in group practices. 
The conference-type seating arrangement accommodates the most number of trainees per area and is appropriate 
for lectures and keynoters.

questions.question: All of the following are considered to be advantages of fan-type seating arrangement at a training site EXCEPT:
options: Allow the trainees to see from any point in the room.
Trainees can easily switch from listening to a presentation to working in teams.
Allows for maximum interaction of trainees with the trainer.
Trainees can communicate easily with everyone in the room.
questions.explanation:
One of the advantages of classroom-type seating arrangement is that it allows good interaction of the 
trainer with the trainees.

questions.question: Which of the following should be the first step in the development of a safety training program?
options: Ensure that qualified instructors are available.
Determine if there is a need for the training.
Set realistic and measurable goals and objectives for the training program.
Ensure that course material meets the objectives of the training program.
questions.explanation:
The fundamental question that must be answered is whether the training program resolves the needs 
of the organization.

questions.question: Which of the following is the BEST example of a hazardous waste handling training program?
options: Students understand and are able to practice the regulatory framework to handle hazardous waste from its point of generation to its ultimate disposal.
questions.explanation:
A training objective must specifically identify what the students can do at the conclusion of the training 
program.

questions.question: Which of the following IS NOT true in regard to the multiple choice method of knowledge assessment?
questions.explanation:
Multiple-choice questions can be graded on a pass/fail basis, and therefore, are very objective (and 
not subjective). 
Multiple choice questions have both advantages and disadvantages. Advantages include easy grading and the 
minimization of guessing. One of the major disadvantages is that they limit creativity.

questions.question: Which of the following must be considered first, before a decision on computer-based safety training is made?
options: The type of software to be used
Internet connection for training at multiple sites
questions.explanation:
Before a decision on computer-based safety training is made, one must conduct a need analysis to 
find out if there is a need for such training.

questions.question: Which of the following is the most important thing to do at the completion of a safety-training program?
options: Measure the class performance by conducting a statistical analysis of student grades.
Review the regulatory portion of the course to ensure that students understand regulatory compliance.
Give a hands-on test to ensure that students can put their knowledge into practice.
Obtain student feedback for continuous improvement.
questions.explanation:
Obtaining student feedback for continuous improvement of the training program is the most important 
thing to consider at the completion of the training program.

questions.question: Malcolm Knowles suggests six assumptions about adult learning. The need to know, the learner's self- concept, and the role of learners' experiences are three of these assumptions. All of the following are among assumptions about adult learning EXCEPT:
questions.explanation:
Role playing is a teaching strategy to assist participants in experiencing feelings and participating 
skills.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT considered to be a distance learning advantage?
questions.explanation:
If a student does not enjoy working with technology, that student will probably get a lot less out of an 
online course. The student must feel comfortable working with computers and online programs before signing up for 
a class. In general, online courses offer more flexibility, lower cost, and the advantage of no commuting compared to 
conventional classroom courses.

questions.question: Bandwidth is an important factor to consider when setting up Internet-based safety training that involves several workstations. Which of the following bandwidths provides the highest signaling speed for Internet-based safety training?
questions.explanation:
T-1, which is a digital transmission link, provides the highest signaling speed for transferring 

information across the Internet. Basically, T1 lines are business connections, while cable/DSL services are usually 
residential.

questions.question: Which of the following provides real-time conferencing and visual exchange?
questions.explanation:
Cisco WebEx provides real-time conferencing and also provides the capability for real-time visual 
exchange. WebEx also provides on-demand applications that can enhance different aspects of business processes 
such as training and sales. Applications are delivered over a global network with a very high level of security.

questions.question: Which of the following is (are) among what participants should learn in an effective safety training program:
options: How to identify the safety and health problems at their workplace
How to analyze the causes of these safety and health problems
How to bring about safer, healthier workplaces
questions.explanation:
According to OSHA, the other component is how to involve their co-workers in accomplishing all of the 
above.

questions.question: A general review of training "best practices" reveals four characteristics that sound training programs have in common. Which of the following is NOT one of these four characteristics?
questions.explanation:
The fourth characteristic according to OSHA is: Practical. Training programs should present 
information, ideas, and skills that participants see as directly useful in their working lives. Successful transfer of 
learning occurs when the participant can see how information presented in a training session can be applied in the 
workplace.

questions.question: Three kinds of "learning exchanges" should be used during training. Which of the following is NOT one of the three learning exchanges?
questions.explanation:
• 
Participant-to-Participant: 'Participant-to-participant' learning exchange recognizes that participants can 
learn from one another's experiences. Participant-to-participant exchanges should be a key feature of the 
training. 
• 
Participant-to-Facilitator: Facilitators can learn as much from training sessions as participants do. On 
many subjects, a group of participants may have more extensive knowledge and experience in certain areas 
than a facilitator. 
• 
Facilitator-to-Participant: Classroom learning needs structure. A facilitator's role is to guide discussions, 
encourage participation, draw out and/or add information as needed, and highlight key issues and points.

questions.question: In regards to the characteristics of adult learners, which of the following statements is incorrect?
options: Adults do not expect to gain information that has immediate application to their lives.
Adults learn best when they are actively engaged.
Adult learning activities are most effective when they are designed to allow students to develop both technical knowledge and general skills.
questions.explanation:
Adults learn best when they have time to interact, not only with the instructor but also with each other. 
Adults learn best when asked to share each other's personal experiences at work and elsewhere.

questions.question: An effective safety education environment must have sufficient space for all attendees to sit comfortably during instruction and sufficient room set-up for participants to interact with one another. Which of the following is not one of the most widely used seating arrangement for safety training?
questions.explanation:
Room Layouts That Encourage Participation and Improve Learning include U-Shape, Round Tables, 
Hollow Square, and Circle.

questions.question: Which of the following is (are) component(s) of an effective safety training program?
questions.explanation:
A sound safety training program must accomplish transfer of knowledge gained to actual work 
situations, its progress be measurable, and have an implementation plan.

questions.question: Threshold Limit Values (TLVs) are published by which of the following organizations?
questions.explanation:
The American Conference of Governmental Industrial Hygienists (ACGIH) publishes the TLVs. TLVs 
are airborne concentration of chemicals that a worker may be exposed to eight hours a day over a working lifetime 
without any adverse health effects. OSHA publishes the Permissible Exposure Limits (PELs).

questions.question: Adults can best learn when they ____________ something.
questions.explanation: Adults learn best when they DO something.

questions.question: All of the followings are considered to be adult learning theories EXCEPT:
questions.explanation:
The cognitive theory addresses how information is processed and remembered. Behavioral theory 
deals with the fact that knowledge is a repertoire of behavioral responses to environmental stimuli. Motivational 
theory deals with how people learn when there is a motivation for learning.

questions.question: All the following are advantages of online training EXCEPT:
questions.explanation:
Benefits of Online training include: 
• 
Flexibility: Students have the freedom to juggle their careers and school because they aren't tied down to a 
fixed schedule. 
• 
Reduced Costs: Online education can cost less due to a variety of reasons. 
• 
Networking Opportunities. 
• 
Documentation. 
• 
Increased Instructor - Student Time. 
• 
Access to Expertise.

60º. What is the magnitude of the resultant force on the bolt?

4) 67 lb

questions.question:
What is the overall noise level to be expected when two machines are 
operating simultaneously in a room if the SPL due to machine X is 95 dB and the 
SPL due to machine Y is 99 dB ? 
 
1) 95 dB 
2) 97 dB 
3) 99 dB 
4) 100 dB 

 
Ans. LPt =10 log [Σ10Lpi//10] 
 
(Total Sound Pressure = 10 times the log of the sum of the 10 to the power of the individual 
sound pressure divided by 10) 
 
LPt = 10 log [1095/10 + 1099/10] 
 
= 10 log [3.2 * 109 + 7.9 * 109] 
 
= 10 log [1.1106 * 1010] 
 
= 100.45 dB

questions.question:
Chemicals with a "C" notation with their TLV's: 
 
1) Are carcinogenic 
2) Are listed in Appendix C of the MSDS 
3) Are either suspect or confirmed carcinogens 
4) Have ceiling TLV limits assigned to them 
 
Ans. A "C" notation denotes that the TLV is the ceiling limit for the chemical listed. This 
means that the assigned TLV is a maximum level that should not be exceeded at any time 
during the workday.

questions.question:
A welder was exposed to airborne lead at a concentration of 270 g/m3 for 75 
min while burning bolts, 40 g/m3 for 3 hr 19 min when welding painted steel, and 
600 g/m3 for 30 min when using an abrasive blaster to remove lead-containing 
paint. The balance of his 8-hour day was spent in an environment with an airborne 
lead concentration of 1.5 g/m3. What was his TWA exposure to lead? 
 
1) 43.4 g/m 
2) 47.9 g/m 
3) 96.8 g/m 
4) 100.5 g/m 
 
Ans. Set up the following table: 
JOB 
C * t = TWA 
Burning

20,250 
Welding 
40.0 * 199 
=7,960 
Blasting 
600.00 * 30 = 
18,000 
Other

46,474 
 
8 hr = 480 min 
TWA = (46,474 ( g/m3)(min) / 480 min = 96.8 g/m3

questions.question:
What horizontal force is necessary to slide a 50 lb wooden crate on a level 
wooden floor? (assume the coefficient of static friction for wood on wood is 0.40) 
 
1) 20 lb 
2) 30 lb 
3) 50 lb 
4) 125 lb 
 
Ans. Ff = uFn, where Ff is final force, u is the coefficient of static friction and Fn is the 
weight of the object being pushed or pulled 
Ff = 0.4 * 50 lb = 20 lb

questions.question:
The ACGIH classifies carcinogens into two categories. The category 
corresponding to Confirmed Human Carcinogens is: 
 
1) A1 
2) A2 
3) A3 
4) A4 
 
 
 
Ans. 
 A1 is the category for Confirmed Human Carcinogens.  
 A2 is the category for Suspected Human Carcinogens.  
 A3 is the category for Confirmed Animal Carcinogen with Unknown 
Relevance to Humans.  
 A4 is the category for Not Classifiable as a Human Carcinogen.  
 A5 is the category for Not Suspected as a Human Carcinogen.  
Substances for which no human or experimental animal carcinogenic data have been reported 
are assigned no carcinogenicity designation.

questions.question:
If 500 cfm are needed to capture air contaminants 6 in. from a hood, what 
volume of air is needed to capture contaminants 12 in. from the hood face? 
 
1) 550 cfm 
2) 750 cfm 
3) 2,000 cfm 
4) 4,000 cfm 
Ans. Required flow rate varies as the square of the distance from the contaminant source. A 
source twice as far away will require 4 times the original flow rate.

questions.question:
The ACGIH TLV-TWA Committee in 1996 and 1997 proposed which of the 
following as a change in the designation of carcinogenic chemicals? 
1) No changes 
2) No longer designate carcinogens 
3) Established 5 categories of occupational carcinogens 
4) No longer publish exposure limits for carcinogens 
 
Ans. The Committee proposed that carcinogens be divided into 5 separate categories to better 
reflect degrees of uncertainty and scientific knowledge. 
A1 - Confirmed Human Carcinogens 
A2 - Suspected Human Carcinogens 
A3 - Animal Carcinogens 
A4 - Not classifiable as a Human Carcinogen 
A5 - Not suspected as a Human Carcinogen

questions.question:
An excellent way to reduce hazardous material inventory in manufacturing is: 
1) JIT 
2) CAD 
3) CAM 
4) QA 
 
Ans. JIT or Just-In-Time inventory control only delivers hazardous materials when such 
items are actually needed by the process, thus allowing for reduced hazardous materials 
storage requirements.

questions.question:
In a pre-action sprinkler system, the water is: 
 
1) Admitted to the piping by the use of a pressure actuated valve 
2) Contained in the piping system similar to that of a wet system 
3) Admitted to the piping through an automatic water control valve that has been 
activated by a zoned heat or smoke detector 
4) Held back from the sprinkler piping by a deluge valve 
 

Ans. Pre-action systems are designed to protect properties where there is danger of serious 
water damage as a result of damaged automatic sprinkler heads or piping. The pre-action 
system is similar to a standard dry-pipe system. To it is added a water supply valve that is 
opened by the operation of an automatic fire detection system (smoke or heat detectors).

questions.question:
Which group of specially trained employees, who have been delegated by their 
employer, is qualified to respond to an emergency in which a drum of hazardous 
substance has been ruptured? 
 
1) ER Team 
2) PEO Team 
3) HAZMAT Team 
4) Any of the above 
 
Ans. All of the above groups, given the proper training that covers the necessary information 
to control and handle chemical substances, spills, and leaks safely, including information on 
the proper personal protective equipment and procedures that safeguard employees against 
hazards and toxic substances exposure, can respond to a ruptured drum of a hazardous 
substance. 
ERT = emergency response team 
PEO = plant emergency organization 
HAZMAT = hazardous materials response team
